entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF789012.
Certainly. Let me pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Grip cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work. I want a refund.
I understand. Could you tell me a bit more about what's not working? Is it a technical fault with the material, or more of a preference issue with the fit?
They gave me blisters on my first long ride. And I can't get the cleats to feel right, no matter how I adjust them. They're just bad shoes.
I'm sorry to hear they caused you discomfort. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I see the delivery date was 25 days ago. The VeloFit Pro-Grip cycling shoes are a standard item, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the window.
Great. So you're going to process the refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive them, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. I guess that's one thing that works.
The email with the label has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do apologize again for the trouble with the shoes. Have a good day.
